ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can manage records and schedules, but bailiffs still decide whom to stop, how to maintain authority, and how to respond to emergencies.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 19,000 bailiffs were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 18,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 400 jobs, with approximately 1,800 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $57,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace bailiffs, but it will accelerate administrative work. Digitization speeds up records, scheduling, and identification, shifting enforcement work from writing forms to on-site response, courtroom order, escort, and custody. Pure recordkeeping roles face the most pressure, while people who can respond decisively and command a room become more secure.
ai_s3_list: On-site response: people handle emergencies.
Maintaining order: human authority matters.
Escort and custody: people protect safety.
Intervention judgment: people determine the right response.
Communication and de-escalation: people manage emotions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, low, places this career in a low AI-exposure area. On-site law enforcement is almost impossible to replace, while only administrative processes are accelerating.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low risk does not mean no impact. Digitization accelerates records and scheduling, not on-site response roles. People who respond effectively and command a room become more secure, while record-only support roles face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When preparing for recruitment examinations, train for physical assessments and study regulations. Pure recordkeeping is shrinking in the AI era, so develop response skills early.
Advance from standing guard to incident response and management, and learn response plans and equipment.
Emphasize discipline and physical fitness, and specify the courts where you have served.
When hiring, look beyond physical build to sound incident-response judgment.

ai_s7_trends: Fully digital records
People remain essential on site
Greater emphasis on response capability

body: Bailiffs perform law enforcement duties in judicial facilities, coordinating security screening, order, prisoner transport, and custody. They use enforcement standards and response procedures to keep courts and detention processes safe and orderly.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can manage records and schedules, but bailiffs still decide whom to stop, how to maintain authority, and how to respond to emergencies.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能管记录排班，但哪个人该拦、怎么镇住场、突发怎么处置，还是法警定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年法警在岗约 1.90 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.86 万人，岗位净减约 0.04 万个，年均产生约 0.18 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代法警，但会加速文书面环节。数字化把记录、排班、识别提速，执法从「写单」挪向「现场处置、秩序维持、押送看管」。真正被挤掉的是纯记录岗，有处置力能镇场的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 现场处置：突发靠人。
秩序维持：权威靠人。
押送看管：安全靠人。
判断拦截：分寸靠人。
沟通安抚：情绪靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——现场执法几乎不可替代，只有文书面环节在提速。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低风险不等于没影响：被加速的是「记录排班」动作，不是「现场处置」的岗位。有处置力、能镇场的人，反而随数字化更稳。怕的是只做记录的辅助岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走招考多练体测与法规，AI 时代纯记录在缩，早点练处置。
从「站岗」升级成「处置 + 管理」，学预案与装备。
突出纪律与体测，写清值过哪些庭。
选人别只看体格，要看有没有处置脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 记录全面数字化
现场仍要人
处置能力更被看重

body: 法警在司法场所执行警务，统筹安检、秩序与押解看管，运用执法规范与处置流程，保障法庭与羁押环节安全有序。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能管记录排班，但哪个人该拦、怎么镇住场、突发怎么处置，还是法警定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: DCS can adjust loads automatically and AI can predict slagging, but plant managers still decide how to handle variable fuel, overnight emergencies, and regulatory limits.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 241,900 power managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 246,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 4,600 jobs, with approximately 17,100 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $121,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Biomass Power Plant Managers, but it will accelerate control-room monitoring and accounting. Automatic DCS load adjustment, AI predictive maintenance, and emissions accounting speed up repetitive work, shifting managers from watching screens toward coordinating fuel, handling emergencies, ensuring compliance, and managing costs. Routine monitoring roles face displacement, while people who understand both operations and business become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI prediction of slagging and tube failures
Intelligent blending by fuel heating value
ai_s2_auto: Automatic DCS load adjustment, startup, and shutdown
ai_s3_list: Fuel coordination: people negotiate supply.
Emergency response: people handle unexpected events.
Environmental compliance: people protect the limits.
Cost management: people make the financial decisions.
Community coordination: people manage relationships.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10, moderate, means this occupation has meaningful AI exposure in control-room monitoring. Systems accelerate load adjustment and accounting, while coordination and emergency response remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Meaningful exposure does not mean high occupational risk. Routine monitoring tasks are being replaced, not overall responsibility for operations. Managers with business judgment who can lead an emergency response become scarcer as efficiency improves. Those limited to reading screens and copying meter values face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in thermal power or electrical engineering and gain hands-on experience with DCS and environmental compliance while in school. Pure monitoring roles are shrinking in the AI era, so develop operations skills early.
Advance from watching screens to managing fuel and controlling costs. Learn predictive maintenance and carbon accounting, and work toward a plant manager role.
Emphasize operations and shift-leadership cases, and clearly identify the generating units you have supported. Power plants value stability and resilience.
Do not select candidates only by education; assess their understanding of fuel and compliance. Plant managers who can run the business merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: DCS and AI improve efficiency, reducing routine monitoring.
Carbon goals and agricultural and forestry utilization create opportunities.
Plant managers who understand business operations and carbon accounting are scarcer.

body: Biomass Power Plant Managers coordinate fuel procurement, storage, and transportation, unit operations, environmental compliance, and staff scheduling. They use DCS and monitoring data to keep biomass power generation safe and economical as the overall on-site leader.
career_ai_description_block.heading: DCS can adjust loads automatically and AI can predict slagging, but plant managers still decide how to handle variable fuel, overnight emergencies, and regulatory limits.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: DCS 能自动调负荷、AI 能预测结焦，但燃料闹不闹脾气、夜里突发怎么救、监管红线怎么守，还是厂长定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年电力经理在岗约 24.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 24.65 万人，净增约 0.46 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.71 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 12.14 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代生物质厂长，但会加速监盘与核算。DCS 自动调负荷、AI 预测性维护和排放核算把重复工作提速，厂长从「盯屏」挪向「燃料统筹、应急处置、合规把控、成本经营」。真正被挤掉的是只做常规监盘的人，懂运营又会经营的人更值钱。
ai_s2_auto: DCS 自动调负荷与启停
排放数据自动核算上报
巡检机器人替代人工走查
ai_s3_list: 燃料统筹：供应靠人谈。
应急处置：突发靠人救。
环保合规：红线靠人守。
成本经营：算账靠人定。
社区协调：关系靠人处。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的监盘区——调负荷与核算被系统加速，但统筹与应急还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「常规监盘」动作，不是「运营总负责」的岗位。有经营脑子、能救现场的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会看屏抄表的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 热动/电气打底，在校多摸 DCS 和环保。AI 时代纯监盘在缩，早点练运营。
从「盯屏」升级成「管燃料 + 控成本」，学预测维护与碳核算，争取当厂长。
突出运行与带班案例，写清跟过哪些机型。电厂看重稳和扛。
选人别只看学历，要看懂不懂燃料和合规。能经营的厂长，值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: DCS 与 AI 提效，监盘缩。
双碳与农林利用给机会。
懂经营碳核算的厂长更缺。

body: 生物质电厂经理统筹燃料收储运、机组运行、环保达标与人员排班，运用 DCS 与监测数据保障电厂安全经济发电，是生物质发电现场的总负责。
career_ai_description_block.heading: DCS 能自动调负荷、AI 能预测结焦，但燃料闹不闹脾气、夜里突发怎么救、监管红线怎么守，还是厂长定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can record data, but Clinical Nurse Specialists still decide which care plan needs adjustment, how to train new nurses, and where the safety limits lie.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Clinical Nurse Specialists is projected to rise from about 3,391,000 in 2024 to 3,557,100 in 2034, a net increase of about 166,100 jobs, with around 189,100 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $93,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Clinical Nurse Specialists, but it will reduce documentation work. Digital systems and remote monitoring accelerate routine records. Specialists shift from writing notes toward case assessment, nursing decisions, quality improvement, and team education. Roles limited to standard documentation face pressure, while assessment and teaching skills gain value.
ai_s3_list: Case assessment: people distinguish complex conditions.
Nursing decisions: people set care orders.
Quality improvement: people adjust workflows.
Team education: people develop other nurses.
Care-team collaboration: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate AI exposure tier. Digital tools accelerate clinical workflows, while assessment and decisions still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Systems replace standard documentation, not assessment, decision-making, and teaching roles. Specialists who assess patients and develop teams become scarcer as productivity rises. Nurses limited to writing records face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build strong clinical skills in nursing and prepare for graduate study. Pure documentation work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop decision-making skills early.
Advance from writing records to assessment and teaching. Complete CNS education and pursue a specialty area.
Highlight your nursing license and specialty expertise, and describe the complex cases you have managed. Hospitals value steadiness and accuracy.
Evaluate candidates on clinical decision-making, not only years of experience. Experienced nurses who can teach teams merit senior roles.

ai_s7_trends: Wider digital adoption reduces documentation work.
Assessment, decision-making, and teaching create opportunities.
Specialists who can educate teams are in greater demand.

body: Clinical Nurse Specialists are advanced practice nurses who provide complex care, consultation, quality improvement, and team education within a specialty (O*NET 29-1141.04).
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can record data, but Clinical Nurse Specialists still decide which care plan needs adjustment, how to train new nurses, and where the safety limits lie.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能记数据，但哪份方案该调、怎么带新人、红线在哪，还是护士专员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年临床护士专员在岗约 339.10 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 355.71 万人，净增约 16.61 万个岗位，年均产生约 18.91 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代临床护士专员，但会压缩记录段。数字化与远程监护把常规记录提速，专员从「写记录」挪向「病例评估、护理决策、质量改进、团队带教」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准记录的，会评估会带教的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 病例评估：复杂靠人辨。
护理决策：医嘱靠人定。
质量改进：流程靠人调。
团队带教：成长靠人带。
医患协同：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的临床区——数字化已加速，但评估与决策还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「写标准记录」动作，不是「评估决策与带教」的岗位。会评估、会带教的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会写记录的护士。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 护理起步多练临床和硕士，AI 时代纯记录在缩，早点练决策。
从「写记录」升级成「做评估 + 带教」，读 CNS，争取专科。
突出执照和专科，写清跟过哪些难症。医院看重稳和准。
选人别只看资历，要看有没有决策脑子。能带教的骨干，值得给高职。

ai_s7_trends: 数字化普及，记录段缩。
评估决策与带教带来机会。
会带教的专员更抢手。

body: 临床护士专员是高级实践护士，在特定专科提供复杂护理、会诊、质量改进与团队带教（O*NET 29-1141.04）。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 系统能记数据，但哪份方案该调、怎么带新人、红线在哪，还是护士专员定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Robots can spray automatically, but people still decide how to set up each batch, correct color differences, and schedule the line.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of Coating, Painting, And Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders is projected to rise from about 165,500 in 2024 to 166,700 in 2034, a net increase of about 1,200 jobs, with around 15,800 openings annually and a 2026 median annual wage of about $47,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Coating, Painting, And Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders, but it will reduce basic roles. Automated spraying and vision inspection accelerate routine operations. Operators shift from holding a spray gun toward machine setup, fault response, process optimization, and quality control. Mechanical-only roles face pressure, while setup and troubleshooting skills gain value.
ai_s3_list: Machine setup: people adjust parameters.
Fault response: people judge defects.
Process optimization: people refine spray paths.
Changeover coordination: people manage the pace.
Quality tradeoffs: people safeguard yield.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure tier. Robots accelerate basic manufacturing operations, while machine setup and fault response still require people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automation replaces mechanical spraying, not process setup. Operators who can configure machines and resolve faults become scarcer as productivity rises. People limited to holding a spray gun face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build machine and process skills from the start of a manufacturing career. Pure operation is shrinking in the AI era, so learn machine setup early.
Advance from holding a spray gun to machine setup and quality management. Learn coating processes and pursue team-lead responsibility.
Highlight yield and machine experience, and specify the parts you have processed. Employers value stability and precision.
Evaluate candidates on machine-setup judgment, not just hand speed. Experienced operators who resolve faults merit performance incentives.

ai_s7_trends: Wider robot adoption reduces basic operation work.
Machine setup and process expertise create opportunities.
Operators with strong troubleshooting skills are in greater demand.

body: Coating, Painting, And Spraying Machine Setters, Operators, And Tenders manage surface-finishing work. They coordinate equipment, coating materials, and parameters, use spraying and inspection methods, and monitor coating formation and quality.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Robots can spray automatically, but people still decide how to set up each batch, correct color differences, and schedule the line.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 机器人能自动喷，但哪批件怎么调、怎么处理色差、节拍怎么排，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机器铺设工、操作员、看护员在岗约 16.55 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.67 万人，净增约 0.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.58 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.76 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代喷涂操作工，但会压缩基础岗。自动喷涂与视觉检测把常规操作提速，操作工从「握枪喷」挪向「调机、异常处置、工艺优化、质量把控」。真正被挤掉的是只做机械操作的，有调机力能处置的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 调机判断：参数靠人调。
异常处理：缺陷靠人判。
工艺优化：轨迹靠人。
换型协调：节奏靠人。
质量取舍：良率靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的制造区——基础操作被机器人加速，但调机与异常还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「机械喷涂」动作，不是「调机工艺」的岗位。有调机力、能处置异常的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会握枪的操作工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 制造起步多练机台和工艺，AI 时代纯操作在缩，早点练调机。
从「握枪」升级成「做调机 + 管质量」，学工艺，争取班长。
突出良率和机台经验，写清跟过哪些件。企业看重稳和准。
选人别只看手快，要看有没有调机脑子。能处置异常的骨干，值得给绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 机器人普及，操作缩。
调机工艺带来机会。
有处置力的人更抢手。

body: 涂装与喷涂机操作工主导工件表面涂装，统筹机台、漆料与参数，运用喷涂与检测手段，达成成膜并跟进质量。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 机器人能自动喷，但哪批件怎么调、怎么处理色差、节拍怎么排，还是人定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the most stable lift path, but an operator's feel still controls a load when wind and sway disturb it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reports that about 42,300 Crane And Tower Operators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 43,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,200 jobs, with roughly 3,800 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $66,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace crane operators, but it will change lifting methods. Systems handle load calculations, path planning, and equipment checks, while anti-sway control and positioning assistance spread. Lifting combines heavy loads, height, and changing site conditions. The operator still makes the final placement judgment.
ai_s2_accel: Anti-sway control systems that stabilize the hook
AI lift-path planning and obstacle avoidance
Pilots of remote control and semi-automated lifting
ai_s2_auto: Automatic load calculations and lift-plan generation
Digital equipment checks and fault alerts
Automatic protection through limiters and weighing systems
ai_s3_list: Hook control feel: fine corrections when a suspended load sways.
Site judgment: immediate assessment of wind, obstacles, and ground capacity.
Signal coordination: efficient teamwork with signal persons and riggers.
Safety awareness: understanding overload and rope-failure risks.
Working at height: endurance for long periods alone and focused.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10 places this career in the relatively low AI exposure range because its core work is moving heavy loads on site. AI mainly automates calculation, recording, and control assistance. Lift judgment, hook control, and site coordination depend heavily on operator experience, so near-term replacement risk is low.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not mean no change. Anti-sway and positioning systems are spreading. Operators who use modern equipment and understand assistance systems will have an advantage. Older methods that rely on force without learning new systems face pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This is a practical licensed skill with broad portability. Certification barriers are manageable, demand is stable, and earnings are solid. Start with thorough safety training and site practice, then progress toward larger equipment.

Learn anti-sway, positioning, and other new systems. Earn higher-level credentials for large and crawler cranes. Moving into heavy equipment and specialized lifts can raise income and bargaining power.

People willing to work hard, comfortable with heights, and interested in a trade can use certification as a direct entry route. Start with tower or truck cranes and learn signal coordination from experienced operators. Emphasize safety records and independent lifting experience in interviews.

Prioritize safety records, then credential level, when hiring operators. Train experienced staff on new equipment and retain them with stable schedules and insurance. Skilled operators are scarce and deserve strong pay.

ai_s7_trends: Anti-sway and positioning systems are spreading, shifting operators from pure feel toward feel combined with system assistance.
Larger equipment and industrialized construction drive demand for high-capacity lifting, while advanced operators remain scarce.
Remote-control and semi-automated lifting pilots are advancing, but site judgment still requires operators.

body: Crane And Tower Operators run tower, mobile, and related lifting equipment for construction lifts, material movement, loading, and unloading. They coordinate load signals, perform safety checks, and maintain equipment. The role is a skilled trade central to construction and logistics.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can calculate the most stable lift path, but an operator's feel still controls a load when wind and sway disturb it.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能算出最稳的吊装路径，但「风一刮、吊物一晃，怎么稳住」，还得操作员的手感来兜底。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年操作员在岗约 4.23 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.35 万人，净增约 0.12 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.38 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.64 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代起重机操作员，但会改变吊装方式：载荷计算、路径规划、设备自检都交给系统，防摇摆控制和辅助定位在普及。但吊装是「重物 + 高空 + 现场多变」的作业，最后那一下落位的判断和手感，依然在操作员手里。
ai_s2_accel: 防摇摆自动控制系统辅助稳钩
辅助定位系统提示精准落位
吊装路径 AI 规划与避障
远程遥控与半自动化吊装试点
ai_s2_auto: 吊装载荷计算与方案自动生成
设备自检与故障预警电子化
吊装作业记录与日志数字化
限位器、称重系统自动保护
ai_s3_list: 稳钩手感：吊物晃动时的微操校正。
现场判断：风力、障碍、地面承载的即时评估。
指挥配合：与信号工、司索工的高效协同。
安全警觉：超载、断绳风险的心中有数。
高空适应：长时间独处与专注的耐力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的主体是「现场重物操作」，AI 能自动化的主要是计算、记录和辅助控制；起吊判断、稳钩手感、现场协同高度依赖操作员经验，短期替代风险很低。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化：防摇摆、辅助定位这些系统在普及，未来「会操作现代设备、懂辅助系统」的操作员更吃香。被挤压的是只会蛮干、不学新系统的老做法。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是「一证走天下」的实用技能赛道：考证门槛不高、需求稳定、收入不错。建议孩子先做足安全培训，从工地实习做起，把大型设备操作作为进阶目标。
把防摇摆、辅助定位等新系统学起来，考取更高级别的操作证（大型吊车、履带吊）。往大设备、特种吊装方向走，收入和议价能力都会上台阶。
肯吃苦、不恐高、想学门手艺的，考证入行是捷径；从塔吊或汽车吊起步，跟着老师傅学指挥配合。面试时强调你的安全记录和独立吊装经验。
招操作员安全记录第一、证件等级第二；给熟练操作员配新设备培训，用稳定排班和保险留人——这行人才缺口大，好师傅值得高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 防摇摆与辅助定位系统普及，操作员从「纯手感」转向「手感 + 系统配合」。
设备大型化与建筑工业化推动大吨位吊装需求，高端操作员稀缺。
远程遥控与半自动化吊装试点推进，但现场判断仍需操作员。

body: 起重机和塔吊操作员操作塔式、移动式等起重设备，完成建筑吊装、物料搬运与装卸作业，负责吊物指挥配合、安全检查和设备维护，是工程建设与物流装卸的关键技术工种。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能算出最稳的吊装路径，但「风一刮、吊物一晃，怎么稳住」，还得操作员的手感来兜底。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can turn participation data into polished reports, but coordinators still make an event engaging and get people involved on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 25,100 Fitness And Wellness Coordinators employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 26,700 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,600 jobs, with about 2,100 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $61,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Fitness And Wellness Coordinators, but it will take over more data and analysis. Registration counts, participation analysis, health-data organization, and program reports can be automated. Coordinators shift from spreadsheets toward program design, field operations, and results. Machines cannot replace needs research, program design, on-site organization, or interpersonal influence.
ai_s2_accel: Health platforms connected with smartwatches and other wearables
AI-generated personalized health guidance and activity plans
ai_s2_auto: Digital organization of health surveys and fitness data
ai_s3_list: Needs insight: interviews and observation reveal what employees actually want.
Program design: direct the budget toward activities with the highest participation.
On-site organization: control the event and adapt on the day.
Interpersonal influence: gain leadership support and motivate employees to attend.
Outcome narrative: explain data as value that management understands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates moderate AI exposure. AI accelerates data and process work, while planning and organization remain the role's core value. Coordinators shift from managing spreadsheets toward managing programs and results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not imply danger. Coordinators who use health-data platforms and prove ROI can secure larger budgets and projects. Roles limited to notices, spreadsheets, and weak execution face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study exercise health or sport management and organize activities during college. Combine credentials such as health-management certification with data-analysis skills. Employers value program and operations ability, not exercise technique alone.
Build skills in health-data platforms, analytics, and event operations, then advance toward corporate wellness leadership. Projects that prove ROI strengthen your negotiating position.

People from HR, administration, or fitness training can transition quickly. Show which events you organized, how many people participated, and what outcomes followed. Data is more persuasive than adjectives.

Wellness programs can become benefits that spend money without results. Assess data-analysis ability when hiring. People who prove value through participation and health data can protect budgets and expand programs.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time steps, heart rate, and other metrics

ai_s7_trends: Corporate wellness is shifting from employee benefits toward data-driven investment in employee health.
Wearables and health platforms expand, allowing coordinators to prove program value with data.
Hybrid online and in-person wellness operations become standard, creating more varied program formats.

body: Fitness And Wellness Coordinators plan and operate health programs for organizations and fitness facilities. They research needs, plan activities, coordinate classes, manage health data, and evaluate results, connecting health goals with employee or member participation.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can turn participation data into polished reports, but coordinators still make an event engaging and get people involved on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把参与数据算成漂亮的报表，但一场活动能不能把人拉起来、让大家玩得开心，还得靠协调员现场张罗。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年健身与健康协调员在岗约 2.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.67 万人，净增约 0.16 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.21 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.13 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代健身与健康协调员，但会接管数据和分析：报名统计、参与率分析、健康数据整理、活动效果报表都能自动化，协调员从「做表格」转向「做方案、跑现场、看结果」。需求调研、方案设计、现场组织与人际推动，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 健康数据平台联动智能手环等穿戴设备
AI 生成个性化健康建议与活动方案
线上健康挑战赛扩大参与范围
数据分析工具量化健康项目 ROI
ai_s2_auto: 活动报名与排期管理自动化
参与数据统计与效果报表生成
健康问卷与体质数据的数字化整理
课程预约与场地使用管理
ai_s3_list: 需求洞察：员工真正想要什么，访谈和观察才知道。
方案设计：把预算花在参与率最高的地方。
现场组织：活动当天的控场与应变。
人际推动：让领导支持、让员工愿意来。
效果叙事：把数据讲成管理层听得懂的价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行的「数据与流程」环节正被 AI 提速，但「策划与组织」是核心价值；评分反映的是工作方式升级——协调员从「管表格的人」变成「管项目、看结果的人」。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于危险：会用健康数据平台、能证明 ROI 的协调员，反而能拿更多预算、做更大项目。真正被边缘化的是只会发通知、做表格、组织不起来的执行岗。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选运动健康、体育管理类专业，大学多组织活动练手。证书（如健康管理师）和数据分析能力都要有，别只学运动技术，企业更看重项目与运营能力。
把健康数据平台、分析工具和活动运营方法论补起来，往企业健康管理负责人方向发展。多攒能证明 ROI 的项目案例，是议价的本钱。
有 HR、行政、健身教练背景的转岗上手快。简历上突出你组织过什么活动、拉了多少参与、带来了什么效果，数据比形容词有说服力。
健康项目容易沦为「花钱没效果」的福利，招人要看数据分析能力——能用参与率和健康数据证明价值的人，才能把预算保住、把项目做大。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 参与率与 ROI 分析

ai_s7_trends: 企业健康管理从「福利活动」转向「数据驱动的员工健康投资」。
智能穿戴与健康平台普及，协调员以数据证明项目价值。
线上与线下结合的健康运营成为主流，活动形态更多元。

body: 健身与健康协调员负责企事业机构与健身场所的健康项目规划与运营，包括需求调研、活动策划、课程协调、健康数据管理与效果评估，是连接健康目标与员工/会员参与之间的。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把参与数据算成漂亮的报表，但一场活动能不能把人拉起来、让大家玩得开心，还得靠协调员现场张罗。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can assist with screening, documentation, and resource matching, but social workers still decide whether a person is currently in danger, how to respond, and how to build a support network.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 136,800 mental health and substance abuse social workers employed in 2024, projected to rise to 150,100 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 13,300 jobs, with roughly 13,500 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $60,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace mental health social workers, but it will assist screening and documentation. Assessment scales, case management, and resource matching accelerate administrative work, shifting social workers from writing records toward assessment, crisis intervention, resource connections, and empathetic support. Documentation becomes faster, while people who empathize and solve practical problems become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Assessment judgment: people determine a client's condition.
Crisis intervention: people decide how to stabilize the situation.
Resource connections: people identify who can help.
Empathetic support: people decide how to respond.
Multi-party coordination: people build the network.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 score places this occupation in a medium-AI-exposure category. Tools assist documentation and screening, but people still provide intervention and support.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-to-high exposure does not mean replacement. Automation replaces form-filling and record-writing tasks, not assessment, crisis intervention, or network building. People with empathy and practical execution skills become scarcer as efficiency rises, while those who only follow procedures face risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation through a bachelor's degree in social work, complete substantial internships, and earn credentials while studying. Documentation is shrinking in the AI era, so develop assessment and crisis skills early.
Advance from writing records to assessment + resource linkage, learn assistance tools, and work toward supervisor or clinical-supervision roles.
Highlight your social-work credential and actual caseload and specify the populations you have served. Organizations value steadiness and empathy.
Do not select candidates solely from credentials; assess whether they solve practical problems. People who build effective networks deserve higher performance rewards.

ai_s7_trends: Assistive tools improve efficiency and reduce documentation.
Mental-health demand rises rapidly.
People who assess needs and build networks are more sought after.

body: Mental health and substance abuse social workers assess clients' mental-health and addiction conditions, develop recovery and case plans, connect medical, family, and community resources, provide crisis intervention and follow-up, and support reintegration into society.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can assist with screening, documentation, and resource matching, but social workers still decide whether a person is currently in danger, how to respond, and how to build a support network.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮做筛查、写记录和匹资源，但这人现在危不危险、话怎么接、网怎么织，还是社工定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年健康物质滥用工人在岗约 13.68 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.01 万人，净增约 1.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.35 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精神健康社工，但会辅助筛查与记录。量表、个案管理和资源匹配把事务提速，社工从「写记录」挪向「评估、危机介入、资源链接、共情陪伴」。真正被提速的是文书，能共情会办事的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 评估判断：状态如何靠人。
危机介入：怎么稳靠人。
资源链接：找谁帮靠人。
共情陪伴：话怎么接靠人。
多方协调：网怎么织靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——文书与筛查被辅助，但介入与陪伴还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于被替：被替代的是「填表、写记录」的动作，不是「评估、危机介入、织网」的岗位。有共情力和办事力的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会走流程的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 社工本科打底，在校多实习和考证。AI 时代文书在缩，早点练评估和危机。
从「写记录」升级成「做评估 + 链资源」，学辅助工具，争取当主管或督导。
突出社工证和真实个案量，写清跟过哪些群体。机构看重稳和共情。
选人别只看证书，要看会不会办事。能织网的，值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 辅助工具提效，文书缩。
心理健康需求猛增。
会评估织网的更抢手。

body: 精神健康与物质滥用社工评估服务对象的心理与成瘾状况，制定康复与个案计划，链接医疗、家庭与社区资源，开展危机介入与随访，支持其回归社会。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮做筛查、写记录和匹资源，但这人现在危不危险、话怎么接、网怎么织，还是社工定。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor vital signs, suggest medication doses, and generate anesthesia records, but a nurse anesthetist's experience and tactile judgment still determine whether an injection will lower blood pressure or tighten the airway.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 53,800 nurse anesthetists employed in 2024, projected to rise to 58,500 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 4,700 jobs, with roughly 2,700 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $223,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace nurse anesthetists, but it will take over some monitoring and data work. Intelligent monitoring alerts, closed-loop assisted drug delivery, and automated anesthesia records are spreading. Anesthesia places responsibility at the bedside, and assessment, induction, and emergency response depend on human judgment. AI assists rather than replaces.
ai_s2_accel: Closed-loop target-controlled infusion systems supporting anesthesia maintenance
AI prediction of anesthetic depth and adverse-event risk
Remote anesthesia consultation and teaching platforms
ai_s2_auto: Automated generation of anesthesia and medication records
Intelligent interpretation and alerts for monitoring data
Digital preoperative assessment forms and risk scoring
ai_s3_list: Airway management: real-time handling of intubation and difficult airways.
Medication judgment: balancing dose, timing, and individual differences.
Monitoring interpretation: integrating multiple interacting parameters.
Emergency response: resuscitation for allergy, hypotension, and cardiac arrest.
Calm communication: seamless teamwork at the operating table.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 score means data collection and recordkeeping are substantially automated. Intelligent systems support monitoring, records, and alerts, but anesthesia itself is a high-risk, high-accountability clinical act. AI can only assist, while nurse anesthetists / physicians must make final medication and resuscitation decisions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium risk does not mean no pressure. Nurse anesthetists who interpret AI alerts and operate closed-loop delivery systems work more efficiently. The occupation is not being eliminated; outdated practice that rejects new systems and relies only on old experience is. As AI grows stronger, people who turn data into clinical judgment become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: To pursue this path, build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in nursing, gain ICU / emergency experience, and then complete a master's degree in nurse anesthesia. Education and certification thresholds are high and the investment period is long, but professional returns and security are also high. It suits psychologically steady students who handle pressure.

Master new systems such as closed-loop drug delivery and AI monitoring alerts, and participate in continuing nurse-anesthesia education and case discussions. Build expertise in complex surgical anesthesia, pain management, or nurse-anesthesia education. Demand for senior nurse anesthetists remains stable.

ICU and emergency nurses have the smoothest transition into nurse anesthesia because clinical judgment is a shared foundation. First understand the local certification path, which in China usually involves hospital-based training / advanced study, then pursue anesthesia-related roles after gaining nurse-anesthesia education.

Anesthesia talent is scarce. Retain staff through advanced-study opportunities + reasonable scheduling + risk protection. Equip practicing nurse anesthetists with intelligent monitoring and assisted drug-delivery systems to reduce screen-watching and direct people toward assessment and emergency response.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and anesthetic-depth monitoring
Automatically adjusts delivery to target concentration
Visualization of nerve blocks and vascular access
Automated recording of the anesthesia process

ai_s7_trends: Intelligent monitoring and closed-loop drug-delivery assistance spread, while anesthesia records become fully electronic.
Expansion of comfort-focused care such as labor analgesia and sedation for endoscopy increases nurse-anesthesia demand.
Nurse anesthetists advance toward greater practice autonomy in advanced-practice roles.

body: Nurse anesthetists are registered nurses with advanced nursing and anesthesia training who can independently administer anesthesia. They conduct preoperative assessment, induce and maintain anesthesia, monitor and adjust medication during surgery, and supervise postoperative recovery.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can monitor vital signs, suggest medication doses, and generate anesthesia records, but a nurse anesthetist's experience and tactile judgment still determine whether an injection will lower blood pressure or tighten the airway.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能盯着监护数据、提醒药物剂量、生成麻醉记录，但「这一针推下去患者血压会不会掉、气道会不会紧」，还是麻醉护士的经验和手感说了算。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年麻醉护士在岗约 5.38 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.85 万人，净增约 0.47 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.27 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 22.32 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代麻醉护士，但会接管一部分监护和数据活：智能监护预警、闭环辅助给药、麻醉记录自动生成都在普及。麻醉是「责任在现场」的专业，评估、诱导、应急处置依赖人的判断，AI 是辅助，不是替代。
ai_s2_accel: 闭环靶控给药系统辅助麻醉维持
AI 预测麻醉深度与不良事件风险
超声引导穿刺的智能辅助
远程麻醉会诊与教学平台
ai_s2_auto: 麻醉记录与用药记录的自动生成
监护数据的智能判读与预警
药品管理与核对电子化
术前评估表单与风险评分工具化
ai_s3_list: 气道管理：插管、困难气道的临场处理。
用药判断：药量、时机与个体差异的权衡。
监护判读：多参数联动时的综合判断。
应急处置：过敏、低血压、心跳骤停的抢救。
冷静沟通：手术台上与团队的默契配合。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这行的「数据获取和记录」环节自动化程度不低：监护、记录、预警都有智能系统，但麻醉实施本身是高风险、强责任的临床行为，AI 只能辅助，最后的给药决定和抢救判断必须由麻醉护士/医生做出。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没压力：会看 AI 预警、会操作闭环给药系统的麻醉护士效率更高；被淘汰的不是岗位，而是「不懂新系统、靠老经验硬扛」的做法。AI 越强，能把数据变成临床判断的人越值钱。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 31,900 remote sensing scientists and technologists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 32,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 200 jobs, with approximately 2,000 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $118,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace remote sensing experts, but it will accelerate interpretation. Deep learning speeds up image classification and change detection, shifting experts from labeling pixels one by one to topic selection, accuracy control, cross-domain applications, and explaining misclassifications. Routine classification is what gets faster, while people with algorithmic skills and sound geoscience judgment become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Topic design: people decide what to examine.
Interpretive judgment: people determine what the ground feature is.
Error explanation: people determine why misclassification occurred.
Cross-domain implementation: people determine how results should be used.
Data selection: people decide which sources to trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 indicates that this occupation sits in a medium-high exposure zone for interpretation. Systems accelerate routine classification, but people retain an essential role in topic selection and application.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. What gets replaced is the task of labeling pixels one by one, not the role of designing topics, explaining errors, and implementing applications. People with algorithmic skills and geoscience judgment become even scarcer as productivity rises. Those who can only apply ready-made models face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation with a bachelor's degree in remote sensing or geoscience, and practice programming and deep learning while in school. Pure classification work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop topic design and implementation skills early.
Advance from labeling pixels to designing topics and delivering applications. Learn deep learning without relying on it alone, and work toward becoming an application lead.
Highlight your algorithms and real thematic project experience, and specify which datasets you have worked with. Employers value accuracy and practical implementation.
Do not select candidates solely for how quickly they can run models; assess whether they can explain errors. Those who can deliver real applications are worth premium pay.

ai_s7_trends: Deep learning raises efficiency while classification work shrinks.
Explosive growth in satellite data increases demand.
Application experts who can deliver results are in greater demand.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates that automation in this occupation concentrates on detection and management. ai_s5_persona.建议: Textile mills have low hiring barriers, making them suitable for young people seeking stability and early income, but choose highly digitalized employers. A vocational program in textiles or electromechanics followed by an apprenticeship can lead toward machine-setting technician roles. Do not remain in a purely physical position.

Build skills in machine setup, processes, and equipment maintenance, and actively use workshop digital systems. Move toward crew leader, process technician, or equipment technician roles. Multi-machine management and quality analysis are valuable additions.

People with mechanical or electrical backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning into machine setup. In interviews, emphasize hands-on ability, endurance, and any factory shift experience rather than simply saying you can watch machines.

Retain workers with transparent piece rates, skill grades, and night-shift premiums. During digital upgrades, retraining experienced machine tenders for setup and equipment maintenance costs less than recruiting replacements.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can handle material nesting, but an experienced welder still determines how to execute an overhead weld without leaks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 457,300 welders, cutters, solderers, and brazers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 467,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 9,900 jobs, with approximately 45,600 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $51,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace welders, cutters, solderers, and brazers, but it will take over some support work. As material nesting, welding parameter recommendations, and quality inspection become digital, tradespeople shift from pure physical labor to high-precision welding, irregular parts, difficult field repairs, and safety management. Experienced workers who perform excellent, safe work in confined spaces and at height are truly scarce.

ai_s3_list: Field welding: machines cannot easily replicate posture and hands-on judgment.
Irregular parts and repair fitting: people adapt to nonstandard components.
Confined-space and work-at-height operations: people adapt to the environment.
Defect diagnosis: experience identifies anomalies.
Final safety responsibility: people must protect high-risk operations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 rating means this occupation has moderately high exposure. Core welding depends on manual skill, with only peripheral tasks digitized.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Do not become complacent about moderately high exposure. Nesting and cutting are being replaced, not welding. Technicians who perform difficult welds and manage safety remain scarce; entry-level workers who only make simple joints face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation at technical school and earn welding and special-operations certifications while enrolled. In the AI era, compete through difficult welding and safety skills, not material handling alone.
Expand from ordinary welding to all-position welding, learn irregular components and brazing, master collaboration with robots, and become a safety technician who can lead crews.
Highlight the materials you have welded, difficult positions completed, and certifications held. Shipyard and pressure-vessel experience is preferred.
Hire for welding skill and credentials, not only strength. Technicians who independently perform difficult welds deserve premium pay.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年焊接、切割、钎焊与铜焊人员在岗约 45.73 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 46.72 万人，净增约 0.99 万个岗位，年均产生约 4.56 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.10 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代焊接、切割、钎焊工，但会接管部分辅助。下料排版、焊接参数推荐和质检交给数字化后，技工从「纯体力」挪向「高精度焊接、异形件与现场疑难、安全管理」。真正稀缺的是能在密闭高空把活干漂亮、干安全的老师傅。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光也别躺平：被替代的是「排版和下料」，不是「焊」。会高难焊接、能管安全的技师永远缺。怕的是只做最简单拼接的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 去技校打底，在校把焊工证和特种作业证考了。AI 时代拼的是高难焊接和安全，别只做搬运工。
从普通焊扩到全位置焊，学异形与钎焊，把机器人协同用熟，升级成能带班的安全技师。
突出你焊过什么材质、上过什么高难、持什么证。有船厂和容器经验优先。
招人看焊接水平和持证，不止看力气。能独立干高难焊的技师值得给高薪。
